script: Look, AI is helping attackers find weaknesses in websites faster. And the pressure is likely to grow. The good news is AI can also help us spot potential vulnerabilities faster. And you don't have to be an expert to do an initial review. Use Claude Code or Codex with web access and this prompt to take a first look at your own website. Ask for potential issues in plain English and what to check first. If you have the code, include it for a deeper review. AI can help with an initial review, but it does not replace a professional security review. Share the findings with the person or company who manages your website.

beats.at: AI can help with an initial
beats.headline: Still get a pro review

rows.text: Here's what the AI review flagged.

takeover.label: SCREENSHOT THIS
takeover.title: Paste into Claude Code or Codex

body.p: Passive security review of [yourdomain.com], which I own. Only check what's publicly visible. No attacks, fuzzing, or load tests.

body.text: Identify the platform and whether it runs PHP. If a PHP version shows, flag anything below 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, or 8.2.35 (PHP2Shell). My host must confirm the patch.
Check for: exposed keys or tokens, outdated software, unprotected forms, missing security headers, HTTPS or cookie issues, untrusted scripts, and exposed admin pages or files.

body.p: For each issue: what it is in plain language, severity, where you found it, and how to fix it on my platform.

takeover.footer: Then share the findings with whoever manages your site.
